title: Changing the Input.mouse_mode causes massive frame drops when using the Forward+ or Mobile renderer. [macOS]
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: all 4.x.stable builds
- Not reproducible in: 3.6.2.stable

### System information

macOS Sonoma (14.8.3) - Godot v4.5.1.stable -  Single-window, 1 monitor - Metal 3.1 (Forward+) - Apple M1 Max - Apple M1 (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Changing the `Input.mouse_mode` to any mouse mode other than `Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE`, while v-sync is disabled, causes a massive frame reduction in the editor play mode and in the final build of the project. 
(800 -> 80 FPS)

This happens only while using the Forward+ or Mobile renderer in every 4.x stable version. (Compatibility works fine)

When you click outside the game window the frame rate starts to recover until you focus the game window again.

List of all the mouse modes that impact the FPS:
`Input.MOUSE_MODE_HIDDEN`
`Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED`
`Input.MOUSE_MODE_CONFINED`
`Input.MOUSE_MODE_CONFINED_HIDDEN`

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a new project using the Forward+ or Mobile Renderer.
2. Go to Project Settings > Display > Window and disable V-Sync Mode.
3. Add a node to the tree and attach a script to it using this code:
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_HIDDEN


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	print(Engine.get_frames_per_second())
```

4. Hit play. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[input_mouse_mode_bug_test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24485200/input_mouse_mode_bug_test.zip)
